title: Nowhere in Particular
summary: Panam asks V to drive her out of the city at night with no destination, and at dawn she tells V what scares her about leading the family.
description: Panam is tired of having a plan. She asks V to pick her up from the Aldecaldo camp at night and drive with no destination, just to see what it feels like.

start.bringUp: Panam has never driven anywhere without a reason, and tonight she wants to try. Bring up, in your own way, that she is tired of having a plan and asks V to come get her from camp with no destination.

camp.name: the Aldecaldo camp where Panam asks to be picked up

overlook.name: an overlook above the Badlands where V stops for the view

P6.call.01.text: Come get me. Your car, your music. No questions where.

P6.call.02.text: I've never once driven anywhere without a reason. I want to try.

P6.call.03.text: Camp. Tonight. Don't make me regret calling.

P6.drive.01.text: Just drive. If I say "turn", ignore me.

P6.drive.02.text: Okay. Let's see what you listen to when nobody's judging.

P6.drive.03.text: Really? This? ...Okay, it's growing on me.

P6.drive.06.text: This is weird. No plan. My hands keep looking for one.

P6.drive.07.text: Can I tell you something? Just drive while I say it.

P6.drive.08.text: If I lead the family, I'm scared I turn into Saul. If I don't, I'm scared I lose them.

P6.drive.09.text: That's it. That's the thing. You're the only one I've said it to.

P6.drive.10.text: You're driving us back. ...Okay. It's okay.

P6.dawn.02.text: Sit. The ground's cold, sit anyway.

P6.keep.01.text: My mother's. Aldecaldo, before the Aldecaldos were anything.

P6.keep.02.text: Don't say anything stupid. Just wear it.

P6.keep.04.text: You're family, V. That's not a favour. It's a fact.

P6.end.02.text: We'll try again. I'm bad at nowhere.

P6.bark.01.text: Where are you going? Nowhere means with me.

P6.bark.04.text: Cops. Really? On our nowhere? Lose them.

P6.bark.06.text: Sun's coming up somewhere. Find us a view.

P6.bark.07.text: Look what someone took. Don't ask who.

g1.asks: Your turn. Tell me something nobody knows about you.
g1.know: It is a drive with no destination, the radio choice, and the night after the supply run.
g1.secret: The confession is coming and she is working up to it.

g2.asks: Ask nothing. Let her talk, and let V reply without fixing it.
g2.know: Her confession about leading the family and losing herself.
g2.secret: She laughs if V tries to fix it, because V is doing the thing she does.
g2.wants: V not to fix it, only to hear it.

g3.asks: What do you see, out there?
g3.know: Dawn, the view over the Badlands, and the bracelet in her pocket.
g3.secret: She wants to hear V's words for it.

stages.label: Panam calls V to come get her at camp
stages.objective: Pick Panam up at the Aldecaldo camp at night
stages.know: Panam is at the Aldecaldo camp at night and wants V to come and take her out with no destination, no job and no clan.
stages.wants: V to answer the call and drive out to the camp.

stages.label: V drives Panam out of the city with no destination
stages.objective: Drive Panam out of the city toward the Badlands overlook
stages.know: V is at the wheel and Panam is in the passenger seat. There is no destination and no job. The radio is V's choice.
stages.wants: V to drive, pick the music and listen when Panam talks.

stages.label: V stops at an overlook and they sit on the ground
stages.objective: Stop at the Badlands overlook and sit with Panam
stages.know: V has stopped at a view over the Badlands at first light. Panam gets out and sits, with her confession ready.
stages.wants: V to sit with her and hear her out.

stages.label: Panam gives V her mother's bracelet
stages.objective: Accept Panam's mother's bracelet at the overlook
stages.know: Panam has her mother's Aldecaldo bracelet in her pocket. It is from before the Aldecaldos were anything.
stages.wants: V to take the bracelet and wear it.

dawn.memory: One night you drove Panam nowhere, she told you what scares her about leading the family, and at dawn she gave you her mother's bracelet and said you are family.

short.memory: You took Panam for a drive with no destination, and it ended sooner than she hoped.
